name: BookStack MCP
description: Search and read BookStack shelves, books and pages from an MCP client; writes need BOOKSTACK_ENABLE_WRITE set to true. Set BOOKSTACK_BASE_URL and an API token's id and secret. MCP endpoint at /mcp. No auth of its own: anyone who reaches it gets the tools, so untick DNS-resolvable to keep it on the internal network, or put it behind a VPN.
